text: Yes, NeoCell Super Collagen Peptides is described as unflavored and flavorless by users [S2, S4], though some reviewers note it has a slightly bitter, chalky, or altered taste [S1, S3]. Reviewers report that the powder mixes and dissolves best in warm or hot liquids like coffee, soups, or sauces [S1, S2, S3, S5], but it struggles to dissolve well and can become chunky or gritty in cold water [S1, S3].
